title: Centralia
logline: A stop in Centralia nobody gets off at: the bus's door open on a wet sidewalk, a bench, a newspaper box, the driver's arm on the wheel, the door closing in the next page that isn't drawn.

panels.composition: From inside a bus: its open door onto a wet small-town sidewalk with a bench and a newspaper box, no one getting on or off, the driver's arm resting on the wheel at the frame's edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen from inside a bus, its open door onto a wet small-town sidewalk with a bench and a newspaper box and no one getting on or off, a driver's arm resting on the wheel at the frame's edge, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
